_comment: Line-less products line_fill.py fills like a named line, by brand: each listed category/subtype is one line whose sizes every product of it comes in. Only where the owner has said so: line-less products are often several real lines (line_fill.py). Ayrloom (owner, 2026-10-11): every all-in-one flavor is sold in 0.5g, 1g and 2g, and every drink flavor at 5mg and 10mg. Owner, 2026-10-11 (line-less interview, batch 1): Hashtag Honey and New York Honey all-in-ones, Hepworth carts and ElectraLeaf pre-rolls are each one line. Batch 2: Leal, Find. and Runtz pre-rolls are each one line. Leal flower is one line (3.5g, 7g, 28g).
_comment_fill_sizes: A rule with a "line" and "fill_sizes" limits the sizes that named line fills (line_fill.fill_sizes). None is set: owner, 2026-10-12, every strain of a (category, subtype, line) gets every size that appears anywhere in that line, sold or not (MFNY's earlier pre-roll allow-list removed).
